channel.title: Celebrity MasterChef
channel.desc: The time has come for the culmination of five weeks of competition between 15 showbiz stars, who are now down to the strongest three as they face off for the title. One will be crowned Celebrity MasterChef Champion 2025. The journey so far has seen them deliver some outstanding creations, worthy of a place on any professional chef's menu, so the chances are that we are in for a night of outstanding cookery. Each celebrity must prepare a three-course meal.
